about: An accordion (U1b, `accordion name faq` with `section` blocks). One section is open at a time, counted from 1; 0 is none. The renderer sends it as the part's `open`, and a handler reads and sets it as `faq.open`. `open` gives the part's state and what `faq.open` reads: the first section without one. `set` gives what setting it sends back. `shown` gives the open section the renderer shows for an accordion of `sections`: the asked one when it is there, else none. `press` gives what a press on the header of section `press` makes the open section: that section, or none when it was the open one, which folds it.
